The witness's signature (CurvesExtendSecondCountable.lean:1401-1402) is `[T1Space M] [SecondCountableTopology M] (C : Causality M) : C.CurvesExtend`, which matches ladder.toml:488-492 (standing T1, second_countable, checked).
